name: @matatbread/matbot-tool-workspace
description: Read, show, write, list and delete files in the session workspace. Files written here are viewable: when a frontend that serves files is running, ask it for a file's link (the web frontend's url_for_resource tool) rather than guessing a URL.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
